newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso ends 4.5 lower vs dlr at 1,060.50.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso ends 4.5 lower vs dlr at 1,060.50.

text.p: Colombia's peso ended 4.5 pesos lower against the dollar at 1,060.50 after coming under pressure from a steady wave of dollar-buying by banks and financial institutions, traders said.
"It was mostly banks that were short (dollars) who were out there buying," said one trader.
He added that a lower-than-expected volume of dollar sales by exporters had also added to downward pressure on the local currency.
Interbank dealers reported 436 trades for a total of $183 million and said the peso hit an intraday high of 1,056.30 before closing at its session low.
